title: feat(spec)!: retire the page kind jsx — refused naming html, its D2 conversion leaves the load path (F5-jsx of #23543)
body:
Part of #23543
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

This PR lands family **F5-jsx** of ruling `6182001882` (item 5) only. F3, F2, F4 and F5-http stay on #23543, one PR each, in the ruled order. #23543 remains open.

## What

Ruling F5-jsx A: `'jsx'` retires from `PageSchema.kind` through `enumWithRetiredValues` naming `html`, together with the `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS` branch; the entry retires.

- **Authoring refusal.** `PageSchema.kind` is now `enumWithRetiredValues(['full', 'slotted', 'html', 'react'], PAGE_KIND_RETIRED_GUIDANCE)` (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`). An authored `kind: 'jsx'` fails `tsc` (it left `z.input`) and, at parse, gets the prescription in place of zod's anonymous enum error: "Page `kind: 'jsx'` was removed in @objectstack/spec 18 (ADR-0087 D2) … Use `kind: 'html'`." At `defineStack` that is `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422 with one issue at `pages.0.kind`. The guidance carries no `os migrate meta` sentence on purpose: the rename belongs to protocol 11, below `MIGRATION_SUPPORT_FLOOR`, so the tool lists no edit for it (the `flow-node-crud-filter-alias` precedent).
- **`COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS`** is `['html']`. `checkPageSourceCompleteness`'s source kinds are `html` / `react`. The `checkPageRequiresKind` refusal no longer names `jsx`.
- **The D2 entry.** `page-kind-jsx-to-html` gets `retiredFromLoadPath: true` and `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'` (the stamp PR #23523 and PR #23600 used). Its docblock's "stays on the load path — a recorded verdict" paragraph is rewritten as the retirement record.
- **The D3 entry.** `18.page-kind-jsx-retired` (semantic, step 18) states the hand edit. It carries no `conversionIds`: no migration step replays a protocol-11 conversion, and `migrations.test.ts` refuses an id no step replays.
- **The verdict-list pin** in `conversions.test.ts` moves the entry to the retired list. A new `describe('page-kind-jsx-to-html')` pins three claims: a stored `jsx` row still converges to `html` and the converted row parses; the authoring funnel no longer rewrites an authored `jsx`; and `defineStack` refuses it with `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422 at `pages.0.kind`, message first sentence asserted, with `html` and a typo (`htm`) as controls. The removal-version pin's `JOIN` gains the row.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **The stored-row path.** Assumption 1's first branch holds: the rehydration seams replay the retired conversion. `applyConversionsToStoredItem('page', …)` runs with `includeRetired: true`. The stored-row readers are `metadata-protocol` `convertStoredItemDetailed` (`protocol.ts`) and `metadata` `database-loader.ts`, so a `sys_metadata` page row written as `jsx` reaches `PageSchema` as `html`. This is pinned in `conversions.test.ts`. The metadata **save** door does not replay page conversions (its `applyConversionsToFlow` fallback is for flows only), so a page saved with `kind: 'jsx'` is refused 422. The D3 entry and the changeset both say so. No credential-redactor-style reader judges a raw page body by kind, so F1's "keep it on a contract face" situation does not arise here.
2. **The `'jsx'` readers.** Re-taken on this tree with `git grep` (non-test `packages/*/src`). Each branch is now unreachable because the parse refuses the kind, so each is deleted; none keeps consumer-side tolerance:
   - `metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`: the local `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS` is `['html']`;
   - `cli/src/utils/sdui-manifest.ts`: `checkedPageKeys` reads `html` only;
   - `cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`: comments only;
   - `lint/src/page-walk.ts`: `SOURCE_AUTHORED_KINDS` is `html` / `react`;
   - `lint/src/validate-jsx-pages.ts`: reads `html` only;
   - `lint/src/validate-page-source-styling.ts`: reads `html` / `react`;
   - `lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, `rule-explanations.ts`, `validate-translation-references.ts`: comment and explanation text;
   - `spec/src/ui/page.form.ts`: the `source` field's `visibleWhen` and help text. The generated `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` was regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, and the three translated help-text values were edited by hand to drop the alias.
3. **`registry.ts`'s docblock** is rewritten as the retirement record (as above).
4. **Generated outputs.** Regenerated through the generators only: `content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx` (`check:generated --fix`) and `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`. `check:generated` reported no change to `api-surface/`, `export-origins/`, `authorable-surface/` or the strictness ledger: an enum-value narrowing is byte-invisible to them.
5. **Re-pointed suites.** `jsx` was the "live conversion" subject of several suites (assumption 5's question). Each now drives `flow-node-http-callout-rename`, the live entry that retires last in the ruled order:
   - cli `lint-conversion-notices.e2e`, `build-json-failure-conversions.e2e` and `validate-json-failure-conversions.e2e`;
   - spec `stack-conversions-record.test.ts` (the "two conversions" case) and `conversions.test.ts` (copy-on-write, `normalizeStackInput`);
   - metadata-core `artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts` FIRING CONTROL 1, which drives `page-component-visibility-to-visibleWhen`.

## Fixture triage (pin sweep, whole repo: `kind: 'jsx'` and the conversion id)

- **Re-spelled to `html`** (they used the alias): lint `validate-jsx-pages.test.ts`, `page-walk-conversion-parity.test.ts` and `validate-action-name-refs.test.ts`; cli `sdui-manifest.test.ts` (two fixtures).
- **Replaced.** These rows pinned the deleted branch:
  - spec `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` (two `jsx` rows) and `page-print.test.ts` (one row);
  - spec `page-requires-compiled-kinds.test.ts`, whose vocabulary pin now reads four kinds and one compiled kind;
  - lint `page-walk.test.ts`, `validate-page-source-styling.test.ts` and `validate-jsx-pages.test.ts`, where the `jsx` rows now assert the rule does not read the retired kind.
- **Unchanged on purpose:**
  - metadata-protocol `protocol.batch-verb-driver-text.test.ts` seeds stored `jsx` rows. That is still a non-canonical stored row that the stored pass rewrites, so only its comment changed.
  - cli `format.conversion-notice.test.ts` formats a synthetic notice.
- **Text that became false:**
  - `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` and `react-pages.mdx`;
  - `liveness/page.json` (the `requires` row's evidence);
  - D3 entries `18.page-requires-non-compiled-kind-refused` and `18.ui-html-page-div-refused`, and the step-18 rationale paragraph for `page-requires-non-compiled-kind-refused` (`registry.ts.template`).

## Changeset

`.changeset/23543-f5-jsx-retire-page-kind-jsx.md`:

- **Bumps:** `@objectstack/spec` minor; `metadata-protocol`, `cli` and `lint` patch.
- It is BREAKING and carries `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. It names the refused spelling, the prescription (`html`), and how stored rows keep loading.
- **ADR-0087 disposition:** `registered page-kind-jsx-retired`.

## Verification

The readings below were taken on `5bf25840`, before the merge; `main`'s incoming commits touched none of this diff's files.

- `@objectstack/metadata-core`: 18 files / 701 passed; typecheck exit 0.

- `pnpm check:i18n`: OK, all bundles in sync.
- **Gates.** `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 118 commands. Each was run one by one, with its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` (with exit codes): "118 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 116 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED".
  - 115 exit 0.
  - The 2 NOT MEASURED, both prerequisites: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (full build absent).
  - `check:platform-checklist` exits 1 on symbol anchors in `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` and `service-storage` (`countable`, `canEdit`, `anonymousFormIntake*`, `envWideRawViewRows`). This diff touches neither file; it is the same `main`-tree red F1's report recorded.
  - Notable greens: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:docs`, `check:liveness`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`.
- **Ablation** (one behaviour, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). The kind enum was spelled back as a bare `z.enum([...four kinds])`, which keeps the narrowing and drops the prescription.
  - On-disk proof: anchor 1 → 0, blob `4ceaa5dffafc` → `35fbaad1835c`.
  - Result: 2 tests went red, the `defineStack` refusal case in `conversions.test.ts` and the `page-kind-jsx-to-html` row of `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` (direction: red).
  - Restore proven: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. Spec tests resolve `src`, so no dist leg applies.

## Acceptance notes

- **objectui (not touched here; objectstack-ai/objectui#12334).** The ruling sized objectui's half as "one line" (the console sample `apps/console/src/sdui-jsx-preview.tsx:87`). At the pinned `.objectui-sha` `b9814b334` there are three more readers:
  - `packages/types/src/layout.ts:1795` declares `PageNodeSchema.kind?: 'full' | 'slotted' | 'html' | 'jsx' | 'react'` on an interface that extends the spec's `Page` with some keys omitted, with `kind` not in `PAGE_SPEC_EXCLUDED`. Once objectui builds against this spec, that override no longer narrows the spec's `kind` (an "incorrectly extends" error, by reading; not compiled here).
  - `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx:611` keeps a `kind === 'jsx'` branch.
  - The `types` zod mirror (`SpecPageFields` from `SpecPageSchema.shape`) will refuse `jsx` at runtime.
  - The Console Pin Gate is not affected now: `scripts/build-console.sh` injects this tree's spec only at the vite bundle step, and objectui's own `tsc` resolves the spec from objectui's lockfile.
- **`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md:138`** still says "The legacy value `kind:'jsx'` is a deprecated alias for `kind:'html'`." That file is a governed (Tier H) surface, so it is left for a separate skills-only PR rather than making this one Tier H.
- **Load-path suites.** After this PR, the conversions still on the load path are `flow-node-http-callout-rename`, F4's two visibility entries, F3's two lifts and `retry-policy-converged`. The suites re-pointed here ride `flow-node-http-callout-rename`, which retires last (F5-http). That PR inherits the "no live conversion left" question F1's report recorded.
